title: Fix Windows PowerShell binding launcher before credential transfer
summary: Reproduced unsupported StandardInputEncoding in PowerShell 5.1. No binding variables were created; launcher now uses compatible UTF-8 transport and safe diagnostics.

changes.detail: Replace unsupported ProcessStartInfo.StandardInputEncoding assignment with UTF-8 StreamWriter on stdin BaseStream; preserves exact bytes without BOM.

Pre-prompt prerequisites and exclusive run lock; sanitized stage-only launcher reports and child stages; no-network synthetic transport self-test. Existing binding preflight/readback preserves create-only resumability without overwrite.

validation.name: Root cause reproduction
validation.detail: PowerShell 5.1.26100.9711 lacks StandardInputEncoding; assignment reproduces PropertyAssignmentException before Node starts. No numerical owner-execution report exists.

validation.name: Vercel inspection
validation.detail: All three bindings absent; all prior metadata including signer unchanged and entry count unchanged. Read-only inspection evidence saved.

validation.name: Windows PowerShell end-to-end transport
validation.detail: SelfTest passed under Windows PowerShell 5.1 with explicit process-only execution policy; exact non-ASCII UTF-8 fixture received by Node. No credentials or network.

validation.name: Real owner execution
validation.detail: No credential re-entry requested during diagnosis. Full production binding application, validation/build and runtime remain pending. No migrations/deployment.
